output:
version: "1.1"
last_reviewed: "{{DATE}}"
system: SCADA-Lite Monitoring System
owner: OT Engineering Lead
applied_regulation: ECC-1:2018

network:
  zone: ot-production
  remote_dashboard_zone: dmz
  firewall_default_action: deny
  allowed_inbound:
    - source: corporate
      port: 443
      protocol: https
    - source: dmz
      port: 443
      protocol: https
  internet_access: false
  intrusion_prevention: true
  ddos_protection: true
  note: Implement protections against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks to mitigate associated risks

authentication:
  method: username_password
  password_min_length: 12
  mfa_remote_access: true
  mfa_privileged_accounts: false
  session_timeout_minutes: 30
  lockout_attempts: 5

encryption:
  remote_dashboard:
    protocol: tls
    min_version: "1.2"
  plc_polling:
    encrypted: false
    note: Industrial protocol traffic stays inside the segmented OT network
  historian_database:
    encrypted_at_rest: false
  backups:
    encrypted_at_rest: true

logging:
  enabled: true
  destination: central-log-platform
  retention_days: 365
  log_privileged_sessions: true

change_log:
  - version: "1.0"
    date: "2025-11-20"
    note: Initial baseline aligned with ECC-1:2018.
  - version: "1.1"
    date: "{{DATE}}"
    note: Added DDoS protection to comply with ECC-2:2024 control 2-5-3-9.
